brief: make a website for our college tech fest called Spark 2026 at Northfield College of Engineering in Pune. students should be able to see the schedule day by day, browse events by category, register for an event with a form, see the sponsors, find the venue, and contact the organisers on whatsapp. it should feel energetic and modern and work well on phones
outcome: Done: the site is workable. Every done-when item passes with Audit's evidence and the render check is clean.

asked: Please send these: What are the fest dates, and can you list the events? For each one, please give the name, day, time and category (for example coding, robotics, gaming).; What WhatsApp number should students use to reach the organisers (with country code), and is there a message you want pre-filled when they tap it; Where exactly is the venue? Please give the full address and the building or ground on campus where events happen.; Who are the sponsors (names, and logos if you have them), and what should happen when a student submits the sign-up form.
questions_to_user.answer: Dates: 14 to 16 February 2027. Venue: Northfield College of Engineering, 22 University Road, Pune 411007. Organisers on WhatsApp: +91 00000 33333. Email: spark2026@example.com. Events: Coding: Code Sprint (day 1, 10am to 1pm, Rs 100); Bug Hunt (day 2, 11am to 1pm, Rs 50). Robotics: Line Follower (day 1, 2pm to 5pm, Rs 150); Drone Dash (day 3, 10am to 1pm, Rs 200). Design: Poster Jam (day 2, 2pm to 4pm, free); UI Duel (day 3, 2pm to 5pm, Rs 100). Talks: AI in Daily Life (day 1, 5:30pm to 6:30pm, free); Startup Stories (day 3, 5:30pm to 6:30pm, free). Registration form fields: name, email, college, event (dropdown); submitting sends an email to spark2026@example.com. Sponsors: Nimbus Cloud, Orbit Labs, Pixel Press (names only, no logos). No photos yet, use placeholders.

done_when.criterion: The page shows the name Spark 2026, Northfield College of Engineering, Pune, and the dates 14 to 16 February 2027.

A schedule section has Day 1, Day 2 and Day 3, each listing that day's events with start and end time: Day 1 Code Sprint 10am-1pm, Line Follower 2pm-5pm, AI in Daily Life 5:30pm-6:30pm; Day 2 Bug Hunt 11am-1pm, Poster Jam 2pm-4pm; Day 3 Drone Dash 10am-1pm, UI Duel 2pm-5pm, Startup Stories 5:30pm-6:30pm.
Events can be browsed by category (Coding, Robotics, Design, Talks), and each event shows name, day, time and category.
Each event shows its price: Code Sprint Rs 100, Bug Hunt Rs 50, Line Follower Rs 150, Drone Dash Rs 200, Poster Jam free, UI Duel Rs 100, AI in Daily Life free, Startup Stories free.

A registration form has name, email, college and an event dropdown listing all 8 events, requires the fields before submitting, and on submit sends the details to spark2026@example.com and shows a confirmation message.
A venue section shows Northfield College of Engineering, 22 University Road, Pune 411007, with a link to open it in a map.
A WhatsApp button links to +91 00000 33333 (wa.me link), and the email spark2026@example.com is shown as a contact.
A sponsors section names Nimbus Cloud, Orbit Labs and Pixel Press.
Where photos would go, clearly marked placeholders are used.
The layout has no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px wide, and navigation is usable on a phone.
The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and every in-page link points to an existing section.
